prompt: For every segment, analyze pedestrian roadway behavior. Name any of these cases if present: (1) mid_block: crossing mid-block outside a marked crosswalk; (2) red_hand: entering/crossing on a red hand or don't-walk signal; (3) against_traffic: crossing while vehicles have green and are moving through; (4) diagonal: cutting diagonally across the intersection off crosswalk lines; (5) between_cars: stepping into moving traffic between cars away from a crosswalk. For each observed case state why in one sentence. If only a legal marked-crosswalk crossing, write legal_crosswalk. If none, write none_observed.
